plain: The 6px and 10px spacing steps are kept: 0.29.0 deprecated them for removal in 0.31.0, and that removal is cancelled; nothing to change.

steps.plain: The off-grid spacing steps 6px and 10px (--primitive-space-px6/px10, hds.space.px6/px10, Tailwind *-px6/*-px10) are no longer deprecated and stay; the 0.29.0 removal in 0.31.0 is cancelled, so code still using them keeps working and needs no codemod.
